utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Quinn, is there any sort of sign-up or organized schedule for the repair drive, or is it just a 'show up and hope' situation?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure about a sign-up sheet — Mr. Henson just mentioned they have new tools, maybe it's more of a drop-in thing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hmm, a drop-in thing without a sign-up? That sounds like a recipe for chaos with everyone bringing different items and no clear plan for who fixes what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing up the old community center!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, I've been telling everyone about it! It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM on Saturday. I'm planning to bring some snacks!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's great you're bringing snacks! I was thinking of bringing some tools—maybe we can get a whole crew together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: So the repair drive's really happening, huh? I've only caught bits and pieces from Quinn, but it sounds like a solid neighborhood effort.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it's coming together nicely! Mara was just telling me how many people are donating tools and time—hoping we beat the bad weather.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hope the weather holds up—I'd hate to miss out on helping, especially since I'm still getting to know everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, I'm putting together a repair drive this weekend—are you in?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late to the convo—yeah, I'm in. Just fill me in on what you need me to bring or do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! Just bring any tools or spare parts you have. I'm telling everyone to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good morning! Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I caught something about that. Saturday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so. I'm trying to confirm the exact time—do you know if it's early afternoon or later?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Kira! We're hoping to fix up a bunch of stuff—lawnmowers, ladders, even some old bikes. Would you be able to join us Saturday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday afternoon? I'd need to know for sure who's running it before I commit—has Marcus actually confirmed the details?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Marcus is definitely on board! He's handling the tool inventory and will be there Saturday to guide folks.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I suppose we should set a specific time for the repair drive. I'm free most afternoons.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli. How about we plan for Thursday afternoon? I can free up some time then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday afternoon works for me. I'll mark it down right now so I don't forget.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh that's great news about the computer lab — my kids have been begging for more after-school options around here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, it's a good addition. But hey, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I might need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but only after the morning school run — the kids have to be dropped off by 8:30 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I keep meaning to get organized for it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I saw their truck on Oak Street an hour ago, but I didn't see where they stopped. Did you catch anything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I think I saw them near the old bakery, but I might be mixing that up with last week's delivery.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, have you heard about the repair drive Oren is putting together?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think Vik mentioned something about that... but I'm not sure if I have it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Oren's got fliers for it — I think he might've left them somewhere, but you should ask him for the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, Mara, I've been tracking supplies and we're gonna need welding gear and heavy-duty cables if we want to get that community center back in shape.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, that's great work tracking that, Cleo. I know Jules mentioned someone might have extra cables from their old shed—let me check with them tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good thinking, Mara. Let me know what you find—I'll hold off on ordering more until we know what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'm back with my tool kit. Let's take a look at that alignment together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got my tools too, let's get started on that alignment.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, let's tackle this alignment. Which part is giving you trouble?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, I'm planning a repair drive this weekend — got a good feeling about it!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful to hear, Vik! I've been talking with Bo and Nell about it too — there's plenty of tools and small appliances folks have flagged for fixing. We'd love your help!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Rosa! I'm glad you're on board. I'll make sure to loop in Noah and the others too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well now, if we're going to coordinate this repair drive, I'd like to suggest we set a regular time each morning for our check-in. That way no one misses a thing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds like a good plan—what time were you thinking? I'd like to be sure it fits with my other commitments.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: How about 8:00 AM sharp? That's when I've just finished my morning coffee and can spare a few minutes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate you checking in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Uli, I've been hearing bits about the repair drive—sounds like the whole block is getting involved. What's the plan for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, it's mostly just folks gathering tools and materials at the community center. I'm not leading it, just helping where I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, fliers! Right, I had some... somewhere. Let me check my pockets—no, wait, maybe the car?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, no fliers on you, Oren? That doesn't exactly inspire confidence. Are we sure this repair drive isn't just talk?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it's definitely real! I just... misplaced the fliers. I swear I had a whole stack right next to my toolbox last Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the tools ready for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've got some tools, but I could use a hand with the alignment.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring the alignment kit. Where should I set up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, are you getting involved with the repair drive? I've been hearing a lot about it from different people.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'm trying to help spread the word — I asked Oren for fliers to hand out at the market, but he's not sure where he left them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I know Oren—he's always misplacing things! I could help you track him down, maybe ask around to see if anyone spotted those fliers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got my tool kit ready to go, just in case anyone needs something for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Gus! Every bit helps — I think Jules might be looking for help coordinating if you're interested.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with coordination too. What does Jules need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been logging the supplies; we have welding gear but need fasteners.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What size fasteners? I might have some in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Standard sizes would work, M6 and M8 bolts. Thanks for checking, Mina!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I remember hearing something about the hardware store too. Was it Marcus who said he'd pick up supplies there?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I think I overheard Marcus mention the hardware store, but I'm not 100% sure. Want to ask him together?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, let's go find Marcus. I'd like to confirm he's the one handling the hardware store run.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Did you say when exactly? I might've spaced on the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, we're meeting at 9 AM by the shed this Saturday! Bring some tools or snacks if you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: 9 AM on Saturday? Got it... I think. I'll try to remember to bring my hammer—if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I’ll grab the other end. Where do you want it moved?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let's put it over by the entrance, near the drop-off zone.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Alright, I’ll take the back end. Ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, sorry I'm late—so it's a community repair thing, right? I've got a few old tools I can dig up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good, Dane. Do you know who's organizing it or what time it starts? I want to make sure we have the right details before we bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I think Cleo's the one spearheading it—probably kicking off Saturday morning at the community center. I can double-check with her if you want.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
